Billy Carson joins Danny Jones to argue that old clay tablets prove contact with star gods long ago. The episode title calls them astronaut gods, an old label for the claim. Carson reads the tablets through that lens.

Carson links Sumerian tales and Bible tales to beings who came down from the sky. He says the texts hide proof of advanced guests in the distant past. Jones asks which lines of text carry the most weight for the claim. Listeners hear the ancient astronaut case made in full by one of its best known voices. The library holds the talk as an archive record, without a verdict.
